A.title: Circuit
reviewNotes: Circuit dark card depths are centrally derived Dark surfaces. Primary tint is an authored emphasis choice, not a nearest-color match.

B.title: Rep
reviewNotes: Paper/card shades are derived from Background. Border and muted text roles intentionally differ.

C.title: Late
reviewNotes: Burgundy depths are Dark-derived surfaces. Gold labels and outlined CTA remain Accent; approving a Primary-owned CTA requires a separate semantic decision and contrast test.

D.title: Odd
reviewNotes: D demo overrides are removed; original native aliases retained. Membership card roles are explicit at end, with fixed tilts. Accent remains the original scrap role outside membership.

E.title: Grid
reviewNotes: Grid status colors keep native Accent/Warning semantic roles. Demo override removed.

F.title: Concrete
reviewNotes: Native form custom properties and final important declarations are included, not just --cn-* aliases.

G.title: Cut
reviewNotes: Original amber alias spans actions/cards/ornaments. Action and highlighted card roles are split by selector; remaining amber ornament uses Accent.

H.title: Storybook
reviewNotes: Fixed pastel percentages are central design choices (Primary16%,Secondary14%,Accent20% into Background); visual approval required.

I.title: Ma
reviewNotes: Image filters/writing mode/fonts are preserved as fixed design. Overlay legibility is a separate adapter.

J.title: Box Office
reviewNotes: Page-level submit/text fixes migrate with section rules. Ticket stub uses Secondary tint.

K.title: Clubhouse
reviewNotes: CSSOM-only capture includes native sections with generated section selectors. Preserve those IDs in proof but require stable-class portability later.

L.title: Midnight Lounge
reviewNotes: Accent actions are deliberate Lounge styling; on-Accent uses Dark. Header color is not reused as universal ink.
